entries.femaleVariant: You have the cache. Good. Keep it isolated—I don't know what it tries to shake hands with yet.
entries.maleVariant: You have the cache. Good. Keep it isolated—I don't know what it tries to shake hands with yet.

entries.femaleVariant: You're Iris? Patch made you sound less cautious.
entries.maleVariant: You're Iris? Patch made you sound less cautious.

entries.femaleVariant: Patch sells confidence. I clean up what confidence leaves behind.
entries.maleVariant: Patch sells confidence. I clean up what confidence leaves behind.

entries.femaleVariant: He called it a datacache. What's actually inside?
entries.maleVariant: He called it a datacache. What's actually inside?

entries.femaleVariant: Courier routes, identity fragments, memory edits. Enough pieces of real people to make the word data feel dishonest.
entries.maleVariant: Courier routes, identity fragments, memory edits. Enough pieces of real people to make the word data feel dishonest.

entries.femaleVariant: I pulled the index and left the payload sealed. Ghostline needs the physical cache somewhere our courier can reach.
entries.maleVariant: I pulled the index and left the payload sealed. Ghostline needs the physical cache somewhere our courier can reach.

entries.femaleVariant: I'll mark a drop point. Deposit it, walk away, and don't wait to see who collects.
entries.maleVariant: I'll mark a drop point. Deposit it, walk away, and don't wait to see who collects.

entries.femaleVariant: Why not keep it here and finish the job yourself?
entries.maleVariant: Why not keep it here and finish the job yourself?

entries.femaleVariant: Because this room is for reading ghosts, not inviting their owners to the door.
entries.maleVariant: Because this room is for reading ghosts, not inviting their owners to the door.

entries.femaleVariant: Already sent. And V—whatever you read in there, leave it in there.
